content.text: In regions where platforms like PayPal and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-honest-side-side-breakdown-18|COREMERCH guide to stripe]] are inaccessible, digital creators face significant barriers in accepting payments for their [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-sell-ebooks-kenya-honest-side-side-breakdown-5|ebooks]]. This challenge is especially pronounced in countries like Nigeria and Zimbabwe, where conventional payment methods often fail. By leveraging cryptocurrency, specifically [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/bitcoin-payments-digital-downloads-every-detail-you-need-6|Bitcoin Payments]], you can bypass these restrictions and maintain financial sovereignty. This guide outlines how to set up a streamlined system for accepting Bitcoin payments, ensuring that you retain full control over your transactions and profits.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-every-detail-you-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Digital platforms can impose high fees and stringent requirements, often leaving creators out in the cold. For example, Gumroad charges a steep 10% on sales, while using NOWPayments allows you to accept Bitcoin with just a 0.5% fee. This difference means that for 100 sales of a $97 ebook, you retain $921 more. By deploying a sovereign commerce stack, you eliminate reliance on third-party platforms, ensuring that your financial transactions are direct, secure, and efficient, empowering you to focus on your content and audience.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before diving into deployment, gather the necessary tools for your sovereign stack. You will require a free hosting solution such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, order management through Supabase or Google Sheets, and file delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Additionally, set up NOWPayments for seamless Bitcoin transactions. These components collectively create a robust infrastructure that allows you to sell your ebooks without traditional payment platform constraints.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your hosting environment, then implement the backend logic to manage orders and payments. For accepting Bitcoin, integrate NOWPayments, which will facilitate cryptocurrency transactions with minimal fees. Ensure that your delivery method for digital products is automated; this can be achieved through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which will enable instant product delivery once payment is confirmed. This setup not only optimizes the purchasing experience for your customers but also establishes a reliable and efficient sales process.
Retain more profit by minimizing platform fees with NOWPayments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your system is configured, perform thorough testing to ensure all components work seamlessly together. After confirming that your payment and delivery pipelines are operational, you can launch your ebook for sale. Promote your product through social media and your existing networks, highlighting the advantages of Bitcoin payments. When a customer makes a purchase, they will receive their ebook automatically once the transaction is verified, showcasing the efficiency of your new infrastructure. Monitor transactions closely to ensure everything operates as expected.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your initial launch, focus on scaling your operations for increased sales. Analyze customer feedback and transaction data to identify areas for improvement. You can expand your product offerings by adding more ebooks or digital products easily. Consider utilizing the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all six blueprints and seven templates, to further enhance your digital storefront and infrastructure. This will allow you to streamline processes and maximize your revenue potential without incurring heavy platform fees.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, implement a sovereign commerce stack using tools like GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for Bitcoin transactions. This approach allows you to maintain control over your sales process and avoid high platform fees, enabling you to retain more of your profits.
Automate your digital product delivery for a seamless customer experience.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell ebooks, templates, or digital products without relying on traditional payment platforms, consider exploring the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit provides all necessary resources for establishing a sovereign digital store with automated payment processing.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
